<subject>SITARA/CPR SYSTEM AVAILABILITY NOTICE</subject>
<body>
Dear SITARA users,

Please be advised that the SITARA system will undergo nightly downtime from 12:01 AM to 4:00 AM Central European Time for routine processing. The system will be accessible again after this period, with positions updated and ready by 5:30 AM.

The CPR system will remain operational during these hours.

If you have any questions or require assistance, please contact the SITARA Support Line at +49 40 1234 5678.

Best regards,  
Nordwind Energie AG IT Support Team
</body>
